paragraphs: DeTect, Inc builds 2D and True3D radar and related remote sensing systems for aviation safety, security and surveillance, drone defense and environmental protection. The company describes itself as the leader in bird radar for real-time aircraft bird strike avoidance, wind energy bird mortality risk assessment and industrial bird control.

The signal processing developed for its MERLIN bird radar also runs in the HARRIER security and surveillance radar and the DroneWatcher drone detection radars. Each system is sold with turn-key delivery and installation, concept-of-operations development, user training and long-term 24-7 remote and on-site service.

DeTect says it has offices, engineering and manufacturing space in Canada, Poland, South Korea, the UK and US. It counts over 20,000 square feet of office, laboratory and manufacturing space in Florida, Poland and South Korea. The company states that the U.S. Department of Defense has purchased twenty MERLIN systems to date. It also states that NASA selected the MERLIN system in 2006 to support space launch safety.
